name: Window Nativizer
description: Rounds window corners to GNOME's radius and adds a shadow only where no compositor, frame or client draws one. Windows that already look like this - libadwaita apps, or GTK and Qt apps drawing the same corners - are left alone. To tell them apart it reads /proc/<pid>/maps and the configured GTK theme; a wrong guess is corrected by picking the window once. Nothing is written and nothing leaves the machine.
